name: Phase-separating protein predictor benchmark
description: A taxonomy-aware, disorder-matched benchmark for evaluating computational predictors of protein phase separation propensity.
reputation: A specialized, well-constructed benchmark in the computational biology community for evaluating phase separation predictors, valued for taxonomy-awareness and disorder-matching but mainly used by domain researchers.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; dataset is specialized and relatively small, with potential contamination if predictors were trained on overlapping sequences; results can be sensitive to class imbalance and taxonomy matching.
